svg.title: From TCP bytes to the Transport struct
svg.desc: The 40-byte TCP SYN carried by the IPv4 packet of the previous diagram, 32 bits per row. The two port fields become source_port 54321 and destination_port 80, the Flags byte 02 is SYN, the data offset A says the header is 40 bytes long with its options, and the payload after it is empty.
